name: com.enioka.scanner.sdk.athesi.RD50TE.AthesiRD50TEProvider
description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi RD50TE handheld for its built-in reader, this service connects the RD50TE barcode scanner for app use.
disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes with the built-in reader on an Athesi RD50TE device.
